target.query:
SELECT toUInt64(event_time) * 1000 AS time, concat('Restart: ', host) AS text, 'restart' AS tags
FROM (SELECT hostName() AS host, event_time, value,
             lagInFrame(value, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY hostName() ORDER BY event_time) AS prev
      FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.asynchronous_metric_log)
      WHERE metric = 'Uptime' AND hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter)
WHERE prev > value
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

SELECT toUInt64(event_time) * 1000 AS time, concat('Lease lost: ', hostName()) AS text, 'lease' AS tags
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE ProfileEvent_CASMountLeaseLost > 0 AND hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

description: Content-addressed (CAS) storage internals for support engineers and CAS developers: garbage-collection rounds, stages and phases; the write path, ref lanes and mount leases; S3 requests by object class. Rows are collapsed; open the one the Overview pointed at.

panels.description: Finished rounds per bucket. `NotALeader` on a host is normal: only the leader runs the fold. Recurring `Error` or `Aborted` is not; `Deferred` is a cheap round that found nothing changed.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, concat(hostName(), ' ', toString(outcome)) AS series, count()
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type = 'Finish' AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t, series ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Rounds per interval, by outcome and host

panels.description: `CASGCIsLeader_<disk>` per host. Leadership moves on restart or lease loss; two hosts at 1 at the same time is a finding (CAS-133 records the leader identity in `gc/state`).

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, concat(hostName(), ' ', replaceOne(metric, 'CASGCIsLeader_', '')) AS series, max(value)
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.asynchronous_metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND metric LIKE 'CASGCIsLeader_%' AND replaceOne(metric, 'CASGCIsLeader_', '') IN ($disk) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t, series ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: GC leader (1 = this host leads)

panels.description: `duration_ms` per finished round, all outcomes. Phase rows do not sum to it: bookkeeping between phases is untimed (CAS-134).

targets.query:
SELECT toUInt64(event_time) * 1000 AS t, duration_ms AS "duration"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type = 'Finish' AND $timeFilter
ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Round duration by outcome

panels.description: Finish rows, newest first, with counts and the error text. `error_code` is the structured twin of `error`.

targets.query:
SELECT toUInt64(event_time) * 1000 AS "Time", hostName() AS "Host", round AS "Round", toString(trigger) AS "Trigger", toString(outcome) AS "Outcome",
       duration_ms AS "ms", candidates_marked AS "Marked", objects_deleted AS "Deleted", entries_condemned AS "Condemned",
       entries_graduated AS "Graduated", entries_redeleted AS "Redeleted", anomalies AS "Anomalies", fence_outs AS "Fence-outs",
       error_code AS "Code", error AS "Error"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type = 'Finish' AND $timeFilter
ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 50
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Last 50 rounds

panels.description: The three stages of the retired-cursor pipeline. Condemned this round, graduated next round, redeleted the round after; in steady state the three lines track each other with a two-round lag.

targets.query:
SELECT toUInt64(event_time) * 1000 AS t, entries_condemned AS "Condemned", entries_graduated AS "Graduated", entries_redeleted AS "Redeleted"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type = 'Finish' AND $timeFilter AND outcome = 'Success'
ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Stage flow per round: condemned → graduated → redeleted

panels.description: `objects_spared` (in-degree > 0 at recheck), `objects_replaced` (412-saves: a resurrection won), `objects_absent` (already gone). A steady non-zero `replaced` means writers race GC on the same content.

targets.query:
SELECT toUInt64(event_time) * 1000 AS t, objects_spared AS "Spared", objects_replaced AS "Replaced", objects_absent AS "Absent"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type = 'Finish' AND $timeFilter AND outcome = 'Success'
ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Retire candidates per round: spared, replaced, absent

panels.description: `manifests_deleted`: owner-removed manifest bodies deleted or found absent (a batch delete cannot tell the two apart).

targets.query:
SELECT toUInt64(event_time) * 1000 AS t, manifests_deleted AS "Manifests"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type = 'Finish' AND $timeFilter AND outcome = 'Success'
ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Manifests deleted per round

panels.description: Running sums of condemned − graduated and graduated − redeleted. These are the durable backlog between stages and cannot go negative the way `CASGCPendingReclaim_*` does.

targets.query:
SELECT t, sum(cg) OVER (ORDER BY t) AS "Condemned − graduated", sum(gr) OVER (ORDER BY t) AS "Graduated − redeleted"
FROM (SELECT toUInt64(event_time) * 1000 AS t, toInt64(entries_condemned) - toInt64(entries_graduated) AS cg,
             toInt64(entries_graduated) - toInt64(entries_redeleted) AS gr
      FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
      WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type = 'Finish' AND $timeFilter AND outcome = 'Success')
ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Cumulative stage differences over the period

panels.description: `phase_duration_microseconds` summed per bucket and phase. On otel.demo `fold_ref_intake` and `pending_deletes` dominate; a phase that grows across rounds is the one to read in the round log.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, toString(phase) AS phase, sum(phase_duration_microseconds) / 1e6
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type = 'Phase' AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t, phase ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Phase durations per bucket, stacked

panels.description: Per phase over the selected range, from the CAS-semantic counters in each Phase row (`CAS<Class><Verb>`; the raw `S3*` keys miss requests made on pool threads). Requests issued on GC worker pools are still attributed to the phase only partially (CAS-135).

targets.query:
SELECT toString(phase) AS "Phase", count() AS "Rounds",
       round(quantile(0.5)(phase_duration_microseconds) / 1e6, 2) AS "p50 s", round(quantile(0.99)(phase_duration_microseconds) / 1e6, 2) AS "p99 s",
       sum(arraySum(x -> ProfileEvents[x], ['CASBlobList', 'CASManifestList', 'CASRootList', 'CASGCList', 'CASOtherList'])) AS "LIST", sum(arraySum(x -> ProfileEvents[x], ['CASBlobGet', 'CASManifestGet', 'CASRootGet', 'CASGCGet', 'CASOtherGet'])) AS "GET", sum(arraySum(x -> ProfileEvents[x], ['CASBlobHead', 'CASManifestHead', 'CASRootHead', 'CASGCHead', 'CASOtherHead'])) AS "HEAD",
       sum(arraySum(x -> ProfileEvents[x], ['CASBlobPut', 'CASManifestPut', 'CASRootPut', 'CASGCPut', 'CASMetaPut', 'CASOtherPut'])) AS "PUT", sum(ProfileEvents['CASBulkDeleteRequests']) AS "DELETE requests", sum(arraySum(x -> ProfileEvents[x], ['CASBlobDelete', 'CASManifestDelete', 'CASRootDelete', 'CASGCDelete', 'CASMetaDelete', 'CASOtherDelete'])) AS "Keys deleted"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type = 'Phase' AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY phase ORDER BY "p99 s" DESC
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Phases: duration and S3 requests per phase

panels.description: CAS-semantic counters from the Finish row's `ProfileEvents` (`CAS<Class><Verb>` summed per verb; the raw `S3*` keys miss requests made on pool threads). A GC round is ~55–100x the S3 cost of one insert on otel.demo, driven by GET and HEAD verification, not PUT.

targets.query:
SELECT toUInt64(event_time) * 1000 AS t, arraySum(x -> ProfileEvents[x], ['CASBlobPut', 'CASManifestPut', 'CASRootPut', 'CASGCPut', 'CASMetaPut', 'CASOtherPut']) AS "PUT", arraySum(x -> ProfileEvents[x], ['CASBlobGet', 'CASManifestGet', 'CASRootGet', 'CASGCGet', 'CASOtherGet']) AS "GET", arraySum(x -> ProfileEvents[x], ['CASBlobHead', 'CASManifestHead', 'CASRootHead', 'CASGCHead', 'CASOtherHead']) AS "HEAD", arraySum(x -> ProfileEvents[x], ['CASBlobList', 'CASManifestList', 'CASRootList', 'CASGCList', 'CASOtherList']) AS "LIST", ProfileEvents['CASBulkDeleteRequests'] AS "DELETE requests"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type = 'Finish' AND $timeFilter AND outcome = 'Success'
ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: S3 requests per round, by verb

panels.description: PUT + GET + HEAD + LIST + DELETE requests of a round divided by objects deleted + marked + graduated + redeleted. Six requests per garbage blob was the otel.demo figure (audit F7).

targets.query:
SELECT toUInt64(event_time) * 1000 AS t, (arraySum(x -> ProfileEvents[x], ['CASBlobPut', 'CASManifestPut', 'CASRootPut', 'CASGCPut', 'CASMetaPut', 'CASOtherPut']) + arraySum(x -> ProfileEvents[x], ['CASBlobGet', 'CASManifestGet', 'CASRootGet', 'CASGCGet', 'CASOtherGet']) + arraySum(x -> ProfileEvents[x], ['CASBlobHead', 'CASManifestHead', 'CASRootHead', 'CASGCHead', 'CASOtherHead']) + arraySum(x -> ProfileEvents[x], ['CASBlobList', 'CASManifestList', 'CASRootList', 'CASGCList', 'CASOtherList']) + ProfileEvents['CASBulkDeleteRequests']) / greatest(objects_deleted + candidates_marked + entries_graduated + entries_redeleted, 1) AS "Requests per item"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type = 'Finish' AND $timeFilter AND outcome = 'Success'
ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: S3 requests per deleted object

panels.description: `CASGCEnumerationPages` (LIST pages the fold walked) and `CASBulkDeleteRequests`.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, sum(ProfileEvent_CASGCEnumerationPages) / $interval AS "Enumeration pages", sum(ProfileEvent_CASBulkDeleteRequests) / $interval AS "Bulk delete requests"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Enumeration pages and bulk deletes per second

panels.description: `CASGCReadAhead*`: read-ahead efficiency of the fold. Wasted above miss means the prefetch window is too wide.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, sum(ProfileEvent_CASGCReadAheadHit) / $interval AS "Hit", sum(ProfileEvent_CASGCReadAheadMiss) / $interval AS "Miss", sum(ProfileEvent_CASGCReadAheadWasted) / $interval AS "Wasted"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Fold read-ahead: hit, miss, wasted per second

panels.description: `CurrentMetric_MemoryTracking`. The ~1.2 GiB saw-tooth per round on otel.demo is the fold's working set (audit F19).

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, hostName() AS host, max(CurrentMetric_MemoryTracking) AS "Memory"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t, host ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Memory tracking per host

panels.description: `CASRootPut` against `CASRefCleanupObjectsDeleted`: the audit F14 balance. Written staying above cleaned means the `_log` population grows.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, sum(ProfileEvent_CASRootPut) / $interval AS "Written (CASRootPut)", sum(ProfileEvent_CASRefCleanupObjectsDeleted) / $interval AS "Cleaned (CASRefCleanupObjectsDeleted)"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Ref-log keys written vs cleaned per second

panels.description: `CASRefSweepDeferred`, `CASRefSweepRearmed`, `CASRefStalePrecommitsReclaimed` per 5-minute bucket.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, sum(ProfileEvent_CASRefSweepDeferred) AS "Sweep deferred", sum(ProfileEvent_CASRefSweepRearmed) AS "Sweep re-armed", sum(ProfileEvent_CASRefStalePrecommitsReclaimed) AS "Stale precommits reclaimed"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Ref sweeps deferred / re-armed, stale precommits reclaimed

panels.description: `anomalies`: fold clamps surfaced and survived. Steady > 0 across rounds warrants reading the round log.

targets.query:
SELECT toUInt64(event_time) * 1000 AS t, anomalies AS "Anomalies"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type = 'Finish' AND $timeFilter
ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Anomalies per round

panels.description: `CASGCUnmatchedRemoveDeltas` (benign per-key no-op when occasional), `CASGCCondemnMarkerUnconfirmedCarry`, `CASGCMetaWriteAnomaly`, `CASGCHeartbeatFenceOuts`, `CASGCStuckRemovals`, `CASGCNamespaceCleanupLeaks`. All but the first must stay at zero.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, sum(ProfileEvent_CASGCUnmatchedRemoveDeltas) AS "Unmatched remove deltas", sum(ProfileEvent_CASGCCondemnMarkerUnconfirmedCarry) AS "Condemn marker unconfirmed carry", sum(ProfileEvent_CASGCMetaWriteAnomaly) AS "Meta write anomaly", sum(ProfileEvent_CASGCHeartbeatFenceOuts) AS "Heartbeat fence-outs", sum(ProfileEvent_CASGCStuckRemovals) AS "Stuck removals", sum(ProfileEvent_CASGCNamespaceCleanupLeaks) AS "Namespace cleanup leaks"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: GC anomaly counters per 5 minutes

panels.description: `gc_fold_clamp`, `gc_anomaly`, `gc_fence_out` rows with their reason and detail map.

targets.query:
SELECT toUInt64(event_time) * 1000 AS "Time", hostName() AS "Host", toString(event_type) AS "Event", namespace AS "Namespace", round AS "Round", toString(outcome) AS "Outcome", toString(reason) AS "Reason", toString(detail) AS "Detail"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type IN ('gc_fold_clamp', 'gc_anomaly', 'gc_fence_out') AND $timeFilter
ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 200
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Fold clamps, GC anomalies and fence-outs from cas_log

panels.description: Live view from `system.cas_mounts` (one backend `listMounts` per query, hence the 5-minute refresh). `state` is the slot as the backend sees it; `lifecycle` is this host's own view of the disk. `is_leader` is NULL on rows describing other hosts' mounts.

targets.query:
SELECT hostName() AS "Host", disk AS "Disk", hostname AS "Slot owner", state AS "State", lifecycle AS "Lifecycle",
       lifecycle_detail AS "Lifecycle detail", dateDiff('second', now(), expires_at) AS "Expires in (s)", writer_epoch AS "Epoch",
       renewal_sequence AS "Renewals", is_leader AS "GC leader", gc_fenced AS "Fenced", wedged_namespace_count AS "Wedged lanes"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_mounts)
WHERE disk IN ($disk)
ORDER BY "Host", "Disk", "Slot owner"
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Mounts now

panels.description: `CASMountRenewal*`: physical attempts, retries after the first PUT, resolved by an exact GET, recovered after retry, stopped by the external deadline.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, sum(ProfileEvent_CASMountRenewalAttempts) / $interval AS "Attempts", sum(ProfileEvent_CASMountRenewalRetries) / $interval AS "Retries", sum(ProfileEvent_CASMountRenewalResolved) / $interval AS "Resolved", sum(ProfileEvent_CASMountRenewalRecovered) / $interval AS "Recovered", sum(ProfileEvent_CASMountRenewalDeadlineExceeded) / $interval AS "Deadline exceeded"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Lease renewals per second

panels.description: `CASMountLeaseLost` (once per Live → TransientNotLive generation) and whole-chain remount attempts / successes / failures.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, sum(ProfileEvent_CASMountLeaseLost) AS "Lease lost", sum(ProfileEvent_CASRemountAttempts) AS "Remount attempts", sum(ProfileEvent_CASRemountSucceeded) AS "Remount succeeded", sum(ProfileEvent_CASRemountFailed) AS "Remount failed"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Lease lost and remounts per 5 minutes

panels.description: `watermark_renew` (only nontrivial renewals: outcome recovered/failed) and `mount_remount` rows from `cas_log`, with `classification`, `attempts_sent`, `elapsed_ms` from the detail map.

targets.query:
SELECT toUInt64(event_time) * 1000 AS "Time", hostName() AS "Host", toString(event_type) AS "Event", toString(outcome) AS "Outcome",
       detail['classification'] AS "Classification", detail['attempts_sent'] AS "Attempts", detail['elapsed_ms'] AS "Elapsed ms",
       detail['step'] AS "Step", detail['error'] AS "Error", toString(reason) AS "Reason"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type IN ('watermark_renew', 'mount_remount') AND $timeFilter
ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 200
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Renewal and remount events

panels.description: `CASConditionalWrite*`. Unresolved = response lost, resolved by a read; DefiniteFailure = the backend said no; FenceLostPostWrite = the write landed after the lease was gone.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, sum(ProfileEvent_CASConditionalWriteAttempts) / $interval AS "Attempts", sum(ProfileEvent_CASConditionalWriteCommitted) / $interval AS "Committed", sum(ProfileEvent_CASConditionalWriteUnresolved) / $interval AS "Unresolved", sum(ProfileEvent_CASConditionalWriteDefiniteFailure) / $interval AS "Definite failure", sum(ProfileEvent_CASConditionalWriteFenceLostPostWrite) / $interval AS "Fence lost post-write"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Conditional writes per second

panels.description: `CASRequest*`: reissues (retries), conflict pauses (409 on one key), resolve reads, gave up, refused, first-attempt fuse.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, sum(ProfileEvent_CASRequestReissue) / $interval AS "Reissue", sum(ProfileEvent_CASRequestConflictPause) / $interval AS "Conflict pause", sum(ProfileEvent_CASRequestResolveRead) / $interval AS "Resolve read", sum(ProfileEvent_CASRequestGaveUp) / $interval AS "Gave up", sum(ProfileEvent_CASRequestRefused) / $interval AS "Refused", sum(ProfileEvent_CASRequestFirstAttemptFuse) / $interval AS "First-attempt fuse"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Request outcomes per second

panels.description: `CAS<Class>CompareSwapConflict`. Root conflicts equal `CASRequestConflictPause` on otel.demo: replicas racing on `_ckpt`.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, sum(ProfileEvent_CASBlobCompareSwapConflict) / $interval AS "Blob", sum(ProfileEvent_CASManifestCompareSwapConflict) / $interval AS "Manifest", sum(ProfileEvent_CASRootCompareSwapConflict) / $interval AS "Root", sum(ProfileEvent_CASGCCompareSwapConflict) / $interval AS "GC", sum(ProfileEvent_CASOtherCompareSwapConflict) / $interval AS "Other"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Compare-and-swap conflicts per second, by object class

panels.description: `CASRefQueueWaitMicroseconds / CASRefBatchedMutations` per 5-minute bucket. Read as a rate over minutes: a single second can sum hundreds of mutations finishing together (audit F25).

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, sum(ProfileEvent_CASRefQueueWaitMicroseconds) / greatest(sum(ProfileEvent_CASRefBatchedMutations), 1) / 1000 AS "Wait per mutation"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Ref-lane wait per mutation (ms)

panels.description: `CASRefBatchedMutations / CASRefBatchFlushes` (3.1 in steady state, up to 34 in a removal burst) and `CASRefBatchFlushes` per second (≤ 5, the lane's bound).

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, sum(ProfileEvent_CASRefBatchedMutations) / greatest(sum(ProfileEvent_CASRefBatchFlushes), 1) AS "Mutations per flush", sum(ProfileEvent_CASRefBatchFlushes) / $interval AS "Flushes per second", sum(ProfileEvent_CASRefBatchScopeCuts) / $interval AS "Scope cuts per second"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Mutations per flush and flushes per second

panels.description: `CASRefAppendWedged`, `CASRefNeedsRecovery` (must be zero), `CASRefAppendSealRejected` (occasional is the protocol working), `CASRefAppendUnwedged`, `CASRefAppendDefiniteFailure`.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, sum(ProfileEvent_CASRefAppendWedged) AS "Wedged", sum(ProfileEvent_CASRefNeedsRecovery) AS "Needs recovery", sum(ProfileEvent_CASRefAppendSealRejected) AS "Seal rejected", sum(ProfileEvent_CASRefAppendUnwedged) AS "Unwedged", sum(ProfileEvent_CASRefAppendDefiniteFailure) AS "Definite failure"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Ref-lane health counters per 5 minutes

panels.description: `CASRefCheckpoint*` and `CASRefSnapshotPublish*`. `IdenticalSkip` means the `_ckpt` overwrite was avoided (audit F5).

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, sum(ProfileEvent_CASRefCheckpointPublished) AS "Checkpoint published", sum(ProfileEvent_CASRefCheckpointIdenticalSkip) AS "Checkpoint identical skip", sum(ProfileEvent_CASRefCheckpointNotAdvanced) AS "Checkpoint not advanced", sum(ProfileEvent_CASRefSnapshotPublishDispatched) AS "Snapshot publish dispatched", sum(ProfileEvent_CASRefSnapshotPublishBackoff) AS "Snapshot publish backoff"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Checkpoints and snapshots per 5 minutes

panels.description: `CASHotKey*`: never engaged on otel.demo in a week. Wait per start in ms, plus cache starts, read starts and verdicts re-read.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, sum(ProfileEvent_CASHotKeyQueueWaitMicroseconds) / greatest(sum(ProfileEvent_CASHotKeyCacheStarts) + sum(ProfileEvent_CASHotKeyReadStarts), 1) / 1000 AS "Wait per start (ms)", sum(ProfileEvent_CASHotKeyCacheStarts) AS "Cache starts", sum(ProfileEvent_CASHotKeyReadStarts) AS "Read starts", sum(ProfileEvent_CASHotKeyCacheVerdictsReread) AS "Verdicts re-read"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Hot-key lane

panels.description: `CASBlobHeadMiss` = new blobs; `CASBlobPutDeduplicated` = content already present; `CASBlobBodyPutAvoided` = body upload skipped; `CASBlobAdoptTrusted` counts the `delete_tmp` repoint re-adopting a part's own blobs, not dedup (audit F2).

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, sum(ProfileEvent_CASBlobHeadMiss) / $interval AS "New (HeadMiss)", sum(ProfileEvent_CASBlobPutDeduplicated) / $interval AS "Deduplicated", sum(ProfileEvent_CASBlobBodyPutAvoided) / $interval AS "Body put avoided", sum(ProfileEvent_CASBlobAdoptTrusted) / $interval AS "Adopt trusted"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Blob publications per second

panels.description: `PutDeduplicated / (PutDeduplicated + HeadMiss)`. 0.27% on the otel.demo workload.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, 100 * sum(ProfileEvent_CASBlobPutDeduplicated) / greatest(sum(ProfileEvent_CASBlobPutDeduplicated) + sum(ProfileEvent_CASBlobHeadMiss), 1) AS "Dedup %"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Dedup ratio (%)

panels.description: `CurrentMetric_CASBlobUploadPoolThreadsActive` / `Scheduled` (max per bucket). Scheduled far above active means uploads queue behind the pool.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, max(CurrentMetric_CASBlobUploadPoolThreadsActive) AS "Active", max(CurrentMetric_CASBlobUploadPoolThreadsScheduled) AS "Scheduled", max(CurrentMetric_CASBlobUploadPoolThreads) AS "Threads"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Blob upload pool: threads active and scheduled

panels.description: `CASBlobUploadFanoutBatches` and `CASBlobUploadFanoutTasks`.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, sum(ProfileEvent_CASBlobUploadFanoutBatches) / $interval AS "Batches", sum(ProfileEvent_CASBlobUploadFanoutTasks) / $interval AS "Tasks"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter

SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Upload fan-out per second

panels.description: `CASPartFolderView*`: hits, misses (rebuild from manifests), invalidations, validation mismatches, oversized bypasses. Misses cost ~3 manifest GETs per merge (audit F9).

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, sum(ProfileEvent_CASPartFolderViewHits) / $interval AS "Hits", sum(ProfileEvent_CASPartFolderViewMisses) / $interval AS "Misses", sum(ProfileEvent_CASPartFolderViewInvalidations) / $interval AS "Invalidations", sum(ProfileEvent_CASPartFolderViewValidationMismatches) / $interval AS "Validation mismatches", sum(ProfileEvent_CASPartFolderViewOversizedBypasses) / $interval AS "Oversized bypasses"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Part-folder view cache per second

panels.description: `Hits / (Hits + Misses)` per 5-minute bucket.

targets.query:

WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter

panels.title: DELETE per second by object class

panels.description: `CASGC*` verbs (objects under `gc/`) over all `CAS<Class>*` verbs, per 5-minute bucket. This is not the collector's share of traffic: its blob HEADs, manifest GETs and ref-log reads are counted under their object class; see GC: round cost for the collector's own requests.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, 100 * (sum(ProfileEvent_CASGCPut) + sum(ProfileEvent_CASGCGet) + sum(ProfileEvent_CASGCHead) + sum(ProfileEvent_CASGCList) + sum(ProfileEvent_CASGCDelete)) / greatest(sum(ProfileEvent_CASBlobPut) + sum(ProfileEvent_CASBlobGet) + sum(ProfileEvent_CASBlobHead) + sum(ProfileEvent_CASBlobList) + sum(ProfileEvent_CASBlobDelete) + sum(ProfileEvent_CASManifestPut) + sum(ProfileEvent_CASManifestGet) + sum(ProfileEvent_CASManifestHead) + sum(ProfileEvent_CASManifestList) + sum(ProfileEvent_CASManifestDelete) + sum(ProfileEvent_CASRootPut) + sum(ProfileEvent_CASRootGet) + sum(ProfileEvent_CASRootHead) + sum(ProfileEvent_CASRootList) + sum(ProfileEvent_CASRootDelete) + sum(ProfileEvent_CASGCPut) + sum(ProfileEvent_CASGCGet) + sum(ProfileEvent_CASGCHead) + sum(ProfileEvent_CASGCList) + sum(ProfileEvent_CASGCDelete) + sum(ProfileEvent_CASMetaPut) + sum(ProfileEvent_CASMetaDelete) + sum(ProfileEvent_CASOtherPut) + sum(ProfileEvent_CASOtherGet) + sum(ProfileEvent_CASOtherHead) + sum(ProfileEvent_CASOtherList) + sum(ProfileEvent_CASOtherDelete), 1) AS "GC %"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Throttling per second

panels.description: `S3WriteRequestsErrors` mixes HTTP 412 (conditional-write collisions, benign), 409 (concurrent conditional PUTs on one key, benign), 503 (throttling) and 500. Only the last two are errors; there is no counter for them alone (CAS-299). `S3ReadRequestsErrors` is not shown: on a CAS disk it equals `CASBlobHeadMiss`.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, sum(ProfileEvent_S3WriteRequestsErrors) / $interval AS "Write errors (all statuses)", sum(ProfileEvent_CASRequestConnectFailureHint) / $interval AS "Connect failure hints"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: S3 write request errors per second (see description)

panels.description: `error` text per event type, grouped, over the selected range. `PreconditionFailed` (412) and `ConditionalRequestConflict` (409) are the storage's expected answers to concurrent writes of one object, not failures.

targets.query:
SELECT toString(event_type) AS "Event", error_code AS "Code", substring(error, 1, 160) AS "Error", count() AS "Count", toUInt64(max(event_time)) * 1000 AS "Last"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.blob_storage_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND error != '' AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY "Event", "Code", "Error" ORDER BY "Count" DESC LIMIT 50
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Errors from blob_storage_log

panels.description: From `query_log`: average PUT / GET / HEAD / LIST per finished query, by `query_kind`. Background merges are not here (see the next table).

targets.query:
SELECT query_kind AS "Kind", count() AS "Queries",
       round(sum(ProfileEvents['S3PutObject']) / count(), 2) AS "PUT/query", round(sum(ProfileEvents['S3GetObject']) / count(), 2) AS "GET/query",
       round(sum(ProfileEvents['S3HeadObject']) / count(), 2) AS "HEAD/query", round(sum(ProfileEvents['S3ListObjects']) / count(), 2) AS "LIST/query"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.query_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND type != 'QueryStart' AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY query_kind ORDER BY "Queries" DESC
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: S3 requests per query kind

panels.description: From `part_log`: average per `MergeParts`, `MutatePart`, `DownloadPart`, `RemovePart`. `NewPart` rows repeat the INSERT's own ProfileEvents and are excluded; merge PUTs are counted at the S3 call site and show in the class panels, not here.

targets.query:
SELECT toString(event_type) AS "Event", count() AS "Parts",
       round(sum(ProfileEvents['S3PutObject']) / count(), 2) AS "PUT/part", round(sum(ProfileEvents['S3GetObject']) / count(), 2) AS "GET/part",
       round(sum(ProfileEvents['S3HeadObject']) / count(), 2) AS "HEAD/part", round(avg(duration_ms)) AS "avg ms"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.part_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type != 'NewPart' AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY "Parts" DESC
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: S3 requests per part event

panels.description: From `cas_gc_log` Finish rows with outcome Success: averages per round over the range, from the CAS-semantic counters (`CAS<Class><Verb>`).

targets.query:
SELECT count() AS "Rounds", round(avg(arraySum(x -> ProfileEvents[x], ['CASBlobPut', 'CASManifestPut', 'CASRootPut', 'CASGCPut', 'CASMetaPut', 'CASOtherPut']))) AS "PUT/round", round(avg(arraySum(x -> ProfileEvents[x], ['CASBlobGet', 'CASManifestGet', 'CASRootGet', 'CASGCGet', 'CASOtherGet']))) AS "GET/round",
       round(avg(arraySum(x -> ProfileEvents[x], ['CASBlobHead', 'CASManifestHead', 'CASRootHead', 'CASGCHead', 'CASOtherHead']))) AS "HEAD/round", round(avg(arraySum(x -> ProfileEvents[x], ['CASBlobList', 'CASManifestList', 'CASRootList', 'CASGCList', 'CASOtherList']))) AS "LIST/round", round(avg(ProfileEvents['CASBulkDeleteRequests'])) AS "DELETE requests/round",
       round(avg(duration_ms)) AS "avg ms"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type = 'Finish' AND $timeFilter AND outcome = 'Success'
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.description: `S3ReadMicroseconds / S3ReadRequestsCount` and the write pair, per 5-minute bucket.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, sum(ProfileEvent_S3ReadMicroseconds) / greatest(sum(ProfileEvent_S3ReadRequestsCount), 1) / 1000 AS "Read", sum(ProfileEvent_S3WriteMicroseconds) / greatest(sum(ProfileEvent_S3WriteRequestsCount), 1) / 1000 AS "Write"

targets.query:

panels.title: New S3 connections per second

panels.description: Every `ProfileEvent_CAS*` (summed) and `CurrentMetric_CAS*` (max) column of `metric_log` that was above zero in the range, largest first. New counters appear here without a panel. 99 of 184 never moved in a week on otel.demo.

targets.query:
SELECT name AS "Counter",
       sumIf(value, name LIKE 'ProfileEvent_%') AS "Events in range",
       round(sumIf(value, name LIKE 'ProfileEvent_%') / greatest(dateDiff('hour', min(t), max(t)), 1)) AS "Events per hour",
       maxIf(value, name LIKE 'CurrentMetric_%') AS "Gauge max in range"
FROM (
    SELECT t, tupleElement(nv, 1) AS name, tupleElement(nv, 2) AS value
    FROM (
        SELECT event_time AS t, arrayJoin(arrayZip(names, values)) AS nv
        FROM (
            SELECT event_time,
                   (SELECT groupArray(name) FROM (SELECT name FROM system.columns WHERE database = 'system' AND table = 'metric_log'
                                                  AND (name LIKE 'ProfileEvent_CAS%' OR name LIKE 'CurrentMetric_CAS%') ORDER BY position)) AS names,
                   [COLUMNS('^(ProfileEvent|CurrentMetric)_CAS') APPLY toUInt64] AS values
            FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
            WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
        )
    )
)
GROUP BY name HAVING sum(value) > 0
ORDER BY "Events in range" DESC, "Gauge max in range" DESC
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1
